fn rs_clone_expr_depth(stage: *RsStage, source: *RmdExpr, depth: u32) -> *RmdExpr {
    if source == null(*RmdExpr) || (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    if depth >= 256u32 {
        rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "semantic nesting limit of 256 exceeded");
        return null(*RmdExpr);
    }
    var target: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, (*source).kind, &(*source).loc);
    if target == null(*RmdExpr) { return target; }
    (*target).op = (*source).op;
    (*target).name = (*source).name;
    (*target).field_name = (*source).field_name;
    (*target).syntax_type = (*source).syntax_type;
    (*target).literal_type = (*source).literal_type;
    (*target).integer = (*source).integer;
    (*target).bytes = (*source).bytes;
    (*target).byte_count = (*source).byte_count;
    (*target).left = rs_clone_expr_depth(stage, (*source).left, depth + 1u32);
    (*target).right = rs_clone_expr_depth(stage, (*source).right, depth + 1u32);
    (*target).arg_count = (*source).arg_count;
    if (*source).arg_count != 0usize {
        (*target).args = rs_alloc(stage, (*source).arg_count * sizeof(*RmdExpr), alignof(*RmdExpr)) as **RmdExpr;
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
        var index: usize = 0usize;
        while index < (*source).arg_count && !(*stage).failed {
            (*target).args[index] = rs_clone_expr_depth(stage, (*source).args[index], depth + 1u32);
            index = index + 1usize;
        }
    }
    var item: *RmdInit = (*source).inits;
    var last: *RmdInit = null(*RmdInit);
    while item != null(*RmdInit) && !(*stage).failed {
        var copy: *RmdInit = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdInit), alignof(RmdInit)) as *RmdInit;
        if copy == null(*RmdInit) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
        (*copy).name = (*item).name;
        (*copy).loc = (*item).loc;
        (*copy).value = rs_clone_expr_depth(stage, (*item).value, depth + 1u32);
        if last == null(*RmdInit) { (*target).inits = copy; }
        else { (*last).next = copy; }
        last = copy;
        item = (*item).next;
    }
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    return target;
}

// Copy each expression occurrence. Keep immutable syntax and literal storage.
// The result has no checked type, symbol, field, or place facts.
fn rs_clone_expr(stage: *RsStage, source: *RmdExpr) -> *RmdExpr {
    return rs_clone_expr_depth(stage, source, 0u32);
}

fn rs_cleanup_number(stage: *RsStage, value: u64, location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdExpr {
    var expression: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_INTEGER, location);
    if expression != null(*RmdExpr) {
        (*expression).literal_type = RMD_T_USIZE;
        (*expression).integer = value;
    }
    return expression;
}

fn rs_cleanup_binary(stage: *RsStage, op: u32, left: *RmdExpr, right: *RmdExpr,
                     location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdExpr {
    var expression: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_BINARY, location);
    if expression != null(*RmdExpr) {
        (*expression).op = op;
        (*expression).left = left;
        (*expression).right = right;
    }
    return expression;
}

// Require a resolved owning source type and an owner place without side effects.
// Return one unchecked seed block. Destroy the record before its owned fields.
fn rs_drop_tree(function: *RsFunction, syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax, place: *RmdExpr) -> *RmdStmt {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdStmt); }
    var location: *RmdLoc = &(*place).loc;
    var output: RsStatements = make RsStatements { first: null(*RmdStmt), last: null(*RmdStmt) };
    if !rs_owns(stage, syntax) { return rs_block(stage, &output, location); }
    if (*syntax).kind == RMD_T_ARRAY {
        var counter_type: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_type_node(stage, RMD_T_USIZE, location);
        if counter_type == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        var counter: *RsLocal = rs_local(function, null(*RmdName), counter_type, null(*RmdParam), location);
        if counter == null(*RsLocal) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        rs_assign(function, &output, rs_place_local(function, counter, location),
                  rs_cleanup_number(stage, (*syntax).count, location), location);
        var condition: *RmdExpr = rs_cleanup_binary(stage, RMD_OP_GT,
            rs_place_local(function, counter, location), rs_cleanup_number(stage, 0u64, location), location);
        var body: RsStatements = make RsStatements { first: null(*RmdStmt), last: null(*RmdStmt) };
        var decrement: *RmdExpr = rs_cleanup_binary(stage, RMD_OP_SUB,
            rs_place_local(function, counter, location), rs_cleanup_number(stage, 1u64, location), location);
        rs_assign(function, &body, rs_place_local(function, counter, location), decrement, location);
        var element: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_INDEX, location);
        if element == null(*RmdExpr) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        (*element).left = rs_clone_expr(stage, place);
        (*element).right = rs_place_local(function, counter, location);
        rs_append(&body, rs_drop_tree(function, (*syntax).base, element));
        var loop: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_WHILE, location);
        if loop == null(*RmdStmt) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        (*loop).expr = condition;
        (*loop).body = rs_block(stage, &body, location);
        rs_append(&output, loop);
        return rs_block(stage, &output, location);
    }
    var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*syntax).name);
    if (*global).resource != null(*RsResource) {
        var call: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_CALL, location);
        if call == null(*RmdExpr) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        (*call).left = rs_named(stage, (*(*(*global).drop).lowered).name, location);
        (*call).arg_count = 1usize;
        (*call).args = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(*RmdExpr), alignof(*RmdExpr)) as **RmdExpr;
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        (*call).args[0usize] = rs_unary(stage, RMD_OP_ADDRESS, rs_clone_expr(stage, place), location);
        var invoke: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_EXPR, location);
        if invoke == null(*RmdStmt) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        (*invoke).expr = call;
        rs_append(&output, invoke);
    }
    var fields: RsStatements = make RsStatements { first: null(*RmdStmt), last: null(*RmdStmt) };
    var field: *RmdField = (*(*global).source).fields;
    while field != null(*RmdField) && !(*stage).failed {
        if rs_owns(stage, (*field).syntax_type) {
            var field_place: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_FIELD, location);
            if field_place == null(*RmdExpr) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
            (*field_place).left = rs_clone_expr(stage, place);
            (*field_place).field_name = (*field).name;
            var drop: *RmdStmt = rs_drop_tree(function, (*field).syntax_type, field_place);
            if drop == null(*RmdStmt) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
            (*drop).next = fields.first;
            fields.first = drop;
            if fields.last == null(*RmdStmt) { fields.last = drop; }
        }
        field = (*field).next;
    }
    if fields.first != null(*RmdStmt) {
        if output.last == null(*RmdStmt) { output.first = fields.first; }
        else { (*output.last).next = fields.first; }
        output.last = fields.last;
    }
    return rs_block(stage, &output, location);
}

// Attach one action to the function's seed-check validation list once.
fn rs_prepare_action(function: *RsFunction, action: *RsAction) -> unit {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    if (*stage).failed || (*action).validated { return; }
    if (*action).statement == null(*RmdStmt) {
        var owner: *RsLocal = (*action).owner;
        if owner == null(*RsLocal) { trap; }
        var location: *RmdLoc = &(*(*owner).syntax).loc;
        var place: *RmdExpr = rs_place_local(function, owner, location);
        if place == null(*RmdExpr) { return; }
        (*action).statement = rs_drop_tree(function, (*owner).syntax, place);
    }
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    if (*function).validation == null(*RmdStmt) { (*function).validation = (*action).statement; }
    else { (*(*function).last_validation).next = (*action).statement; }
    (*function).last_validation = (*action).statement;
    (*action).validated = true;
}
